notes: VERDICT: Proxy fix VERIFIED WORKING. Coverage jumped from 0%→47% (8 real images now load via proxy). However, the task spec's ≥90% target is NOT met because 9 of 17 visible tokens have no imageUrls persisted in the backend (proven by backend returning 404 for proxy requests). The proxy itself works perfectly — image/webp 200 responses confirm end-to-end pipeline. Lighthouse regressed slightly (56→52) due to real image loading adding async fetch cost and CLS, but FCP/LCP/SI unchanged. The 90% target would require: (a) populating imageUrls for the 9 placeholder tokens via enrichment jobs, or (b) re-snapshotting tokens that lack provider coverage.
